title: Gargoyle Oracle Sphere
description: A large grey gargoyle-like creature with bat wings, multiple glowing white eyes, and a staff stands on a stone path, holding a glowing crystal ball that displays a red-hued castle and planet. In the background, a small astronaut figure walks the path toward the creature under a black sky filled with a ringed red planet and abstract faces.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a large grey gargoyle creature with bat-like wings, multiple glowing white eyes, and a staff, standing on a geometric stone path. The creature holds a large glowing crystal sphere showing a red castle and ringed planet inside. A small astronaut walks the path toward the gargoyle. Black sky with a prominent red ringed planet and abstract floating faces in the background, purple ground with white plant motifs, mystical and eerie atmosphere.
